The database schema named "schemabench_0165" consists of 11 tables. The main table is "athlete", which contains information about athletes, including their names, gender, function, country, nationality, height, weight, disciplines, events, birth date, birth place, residence place, residence country, nickname, hobbies, occupation, education, family, languages, coach, reason, hero, influence, philosophy, sporting relatives, ritual, and other sports.
The "coach" table contains information about coaches, including their names, gender, function, category, country, disciplines, and events.
The "event" table contains information about events, including the event name, tag, sport, sport code, and sport URL.
The "medalist" table contains information about medalists, including the medal date, medal type, medal code, name, gender, country, nationality, team, team gender, discipline, event, event type, birth date, and code.
The "medal" table contains information about medals, including the medal type, medal code, medal date, name, country code, gender, discipline, event, event type, and URL of the event.
The "medal_total" table contains information about the total number of medals won by each country, including the number of gold, silver, bronze, and total medals.
The "schedule" table contains information about the schedule of events, including the start date, end date, day, status, discipline, discipline code, event, event medal, phase, gender, event type, venue, venue code, location description, location code, and URL.
The "schedule_preliminary" table contains preliminary information about the schedule of events, including the start date, end date, estimated start, start text, medal, venue code, description, venue code other, description other, team 1 code, team 1, team 2 code, team 2, tag, sport, sport code, sport URL, and URL of the event.
The "team" table contains information about teams, including the code, team, team gender, country, country full, country code, discipline, disciplines code, events, athletes, coaches, athletes codes, number of athletes, coaches codes, and number of coaches.
The "torch_route" table contains information about the torch routes, including the title, city, start date, end date, tag, URL, and stage number.
The "venue" table contains information about venues, including the venue, sports, start date, end date, tag, and URL.

1) Background / Context
The project focuses on developing a comprehensive data analytics and data warehouse solution for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games. The system will manage and analyze data related to the event, encompassing participating countries, athletes, sports disciplines, medal standings, event details, and more. This repository provides a structured framework for processing and understanding extensive datasets associated with the 2024 Olympics.

 2) Objectives
- To create an efficient data warehouse for storing and managing data related to the Paris 2024 Olympics.
- To provide tools and functionalities for analyzing various aspects of the Olympic data, such as athlete performance, medal standings, and event schedules.
- To support data-driven decision-making and insights generation for stakeholders involved in the Olympics.

 3) Stakeholders & Users
- Olympic Organizing Committee: Oversees the setup and operation of the Olympics, using data for planning and logistics.
- Athletes and Coaches: Access performance data and schedules for strategic preparation and participation.
- Sports Analysts and Journalists: Utilize data insights for reporting and analysis of the event.
- Fans and Spectators: Access event schedules and results.

 4) Functional Descriptions
- Athlete Management: Manage data related to athletes, including personal information, disciplines, and event participation.
- Coach Management: Store and manage coach details and their roles within different sports disciplines.
- Event Schedule and Results: Manage event scheduling, phases, and results tracking, including medal distribution.
- Medal Tracking: Record and analyze medal standings by country and event.
- Team Management: Manage data related to teams, including athletes and coaches details.
- Venue and Torch Route Management: Track venues and torch relay routes with related details and scheduling.
  
 5) Non-Functional Descriptions
- Scalability: The system should efficiently handle large volumes of data related to multiple aspects of the Olympic Games.
- Performance: Ensure quick data retrieval and analysis capabilities.
- Security: Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data, including personal information of athletes and event details.
- Usability: Provide user-friendly interfaces for different stakeholders to interact with the data system seamlessly.
- Reliability: Ensure data accuracy and system uptime during the Olympic Games period for real-time access.
